periods.label: Western lord and Celistia's father

status.role: handles New Kingdom internal administration while Lux serves as formal king

periods.summary: Celistia's father and a major noble who supports Lux's provisional kingship. During Lux's visit he confesses his regret over failing to shield Ilse from noble prejudice and urges Lux not to repeat that failure.

lux-arcadia.summary: Entrusts Celistia to Lux and supports his kingship.

celistia-langris.summary: Proud of her but aware of the burden noble inheritance placed on her.

ilse-langris.summary: Loves her and regrets that he could not fully protect her social standing.

key_events.summary: Speaks privately with Lux about noble marriage pressure, male-heir expectations and protecting Celistia.
